approval.request.description: Reserved: request a tool approval (approvals are raised by the Hub as approval.requested events).

approval.respond.description: Resolve a pending tool approval as approved or denied.

capability.progress.description: Report progress for a pending capability request owned by the sending client.

capability.request.description: Ask a target client to execute a capability for a session and reply with its result.

capability.respond.description: Resolve a pending capability request owned by the sending client.

catalog.list.description: List catalog entries (reserved; not handled by the Hub).

client.list.description: List clients registered with the Hub.

client.register.description: Register the connection's client (identity, capabilities, workspace) with the Hub.

client.unregister.description: Unregister the client named by envelope.clientId.

client.update.description: Update the registered client's metadata and/or capabilities (client from envelope.clientId).

cline.account.get_current.description: Get the current Cline account (reserved; not handled by the Hub).

connector.channels.description: List available, active, and configured connector channels.

connector.configure.description: Save a connector channel's field values and security settings.

connector.delete_config.description: Delete a connector channel's saved configuration.

connector.start.description: Start (or restart) a Hub-supervised connector instance.

connector.supervised.description: List connector instances supervised by the Hub.

cron.event.get.description: Get one ingested automation event (no Hub handler yet).

cron.event.ingest.description: Ingest a normalized automation event (no Hub handler yet).

cron.event.list.description: List ingested automation events (no Hub handler yet).

hub.drain.description: Enter (default) or leave drain mode, refusing new mutating work while runs finish.

hub.status.description: Report the Hub's drain state and activity.

mention_files.search.description: Search files for @-mentions (reserved; not handled by the Hub).

peer.attach_session.description: Reserved: attach to a peer hub's session (not implemented).

peer.detach_session.description: Reserved: detach from a peer hub's session (not implemented).

peer.list_sessions.description: Reserved: list a peer hub's sessions (not implemented).

peer.proxy_command.description: Reserved: proxy a command to a peer hub (not implemented).

peer.register.description: Reserved: register a peer hub (not implemented).

prompt_commands.execute.description: Execute a prompt command (reserved; not handled by the Hub).

prompt_commands.list.description: List prompt (slash) commands (reserved; not handled by the Hub).

run.abort.description: Abort the session's active run and cancel its pending approvals and capability requests.

run.enqueue.description: Durably queue a turn for a session and ack immediately with its run id.

run.list.description: List durable run queue records, optionally for one session.

run.proceed_while_running.description: Detach running foreground commands so the agent can continue the turn.

run.start.description: Run one agent turn in a session and reply when the turn settles.

schedule.create.description: Create a recurring or one-off schedule in the client workspace.

schedule.list.description: List schedules in the client workspace (or all workspaces).

schedule.list_executions.description: List schedule executions, optionally for one schedule.

schedule.stats.description: Get execution statistics for one schedule.

schedule.trigger.description: Run a schedule now, optionally without waiting for completion.

schedule.update.description: Update fields of an existing schedule.

session.attach.description: Join an existing session as a participant.

session.compaction.get.description: Read a session's compaction state (owner client only).

session.compaction.update.description: Replace a session's compaction state (owner client only).

session.create.description: Start a new runtime session owned by the calling client.

session.delete.description: Delete a session and its derived state.

session.detach.description: Leave a session and cancel the client's pending capability requests.

session.fork.description: Fork a session (reserved; the Hub has no handler yet).

session.get.description: Read a session record, optionally with its core snapshot.

session.hook.description: Dispatch a hook event payload into the session runtime.

session.list.description: List recent sessions known to the Hub.

session.messages.description: Read a session's persisted message transcript.

session.pending_prompts.description: List a session's queued pending prompts.

session.restore.description: Restore a session checkpoint, optionally starting a new session from it.

session.send_input.description: Send user input to a session, running a turn (alias of run.start).

session.steer_first_pending_prompt.description: Promote the first queued prompt to steer delivery.

session.update.description: Merge client metadata into a session record.

session.update_connection.description: Change a live session's provider, model, or reasoning settings.

session.update_pending_prompt.description: Edit a queued prompt's text or delivery mode.

settings.get.description: Get a settings value (not implemented yet).

settings.list.description: List skills, workflows, rules, plugins, tools, and MCP settings for a workspace.

settings.toggle.description: Enable or disable a skill, workflow, rule, plugin, tool, or MCP server.

task.approve.description: Approve an agenda task at an expected revision.

task.automation.get.description: Get the agenda automation policy for the client workspace.

task.automation.set.description: Set the agenda automation policy for the client workspace.

task.cancel.description: Cancel an agenda task at an expected revision.

task.create.description: Create a user-authored agenda task in the client workspace.

task.get.description: Get one agenda task by id.

task.list.description: List workspace and global agenda tasks.

task.run.description: Start a run of an approved agenda task.

task.update.description: Edit an agenda task at an expected revision.

ui.notify.description: Broadcast a ui.notify event (payload forwarded verbatim) to subscribers.

ui.show_window.description: Broadcast a ui.show_window event (payload forwarded verbatim) to subscribers.

agent.done.description: The agent loop reported it finished.

approval.requested.description: A tool call is waiting for client approval.

approval.resolved.description: A pending tool approval was answered or cancelled.

artifact.created.description: An artifact was created (not currently emitted).

assistant.delta.description: A non-empty chunk of assistant text.

assistant.media.description: Generated media returned by the model.

capability.requested.description: The Hub asks a specific client to run a capability.

capability.resolved.description: A capability request was answered or cancelled.

diff.created.description: A diff was created (not currently emitted).

hub.client.disconnected.description: A client unregistered from the Hub.

hub.client.registered.description: A client registered with the Hub.

hub.client.updated.description: A client's registration changed (not currently emitted).

hub.drain_changed.description: The Hub entered or left drain mode.

peer.registered.description: A peer Hub registered (not currently emitted).

peer.session_attached.description: A peer attached to a session (not currently emitted).

peer.session_detached.description: A peer detached from a session (not currently emitted).

reasoning.delta.description: A chunk of model reasoning, possibly redacted.

run.aborted.description: A run ended because it was aborted.

run.enqueued.description: A run was accepted into the durable run queue.

run.failed.description: A run ended with an error.

run.heartbeat.description: Periodic liveness signal for a long-running turn.

run.interrupted.description: A queued run was interrupted by a Hub restart.

schedule.execution_failed.description: A scheduled run failed or was cancelled.

schedule.updated.description: A schedule was updated, enabled, or disabled.

session.attached.description: A client attached to a session as a participant.

session.created.description: A session was created or restored from a checkpoint.

session.detached.description: A client detached from a session.

session.forked.description: A session was forked (not currently emitted).

session.notice.description: An agent notice (recovery, stop, or status).

session.pending_prompt_submitted.description: A queued prompt left the queue and started a turn.

session.pending_prompts.description: Full snapshot of a session's pending prompt queue.

session.updated.description: A session's record or snapshot changed.

team.progress.description: Team progress projection for a multi-agent session.

ui.notify.description: A user-facing notification for UI clients.

ui.show_window.description: Ask UI clients to show a window.

usage.updated.description: Token and cost usage for a model turn plus running totals.
